content:
iPhone 18 Pro will be unveiled next week, and a new post from a reputable Weibo leaker names three new colors expected to debut.

iPhone 18 Pro could have three all-new colors, with no repeats from last year

Next week at its September event, Apple will reveal all the details of its new flagship iPhone models.

iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will launch alongside iPhone Ultra. And rumors have revealed a lot of what to expect already.

Colors always seem like one of the last details to be finalized by Apple. But this year, consensus has largely pointed to a Dark Cherry/Burgundy as the flagship replacement for Cosmic Orange, plus a new Silver and a Sky Blue.

Reports have conflicted on whether Apple will have a Black/Space Gray model this year.

But a new post from Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital points to a slightly different color lineup. He predicts:

  • Dark Cherry/Burgundy
  • Sky Blue
  • Black

The leaker says Silver will “most likely” not be available, adding in a follow-up post that he’s seen no evidence of the model coming. And if this lineup proves accurate, that means Apple is replacing the full roster of iPhone 17 Pro colors with all-new options for iPhone 18 Pro.

Sky Blue has been used for iPhone Air and MacBook Air before, and in both cases the blue is very subtle. In everyday lighting it appears more like a silver finish. So it’s possible Apple is banking on Sky Blue being a good replacement for shoppers who prefer Silver.

Many users were disappointed last year that there was no Black or Space Gray option of iPhone 17 Pro. So here’s hoping this latest leak proves true and Black returns in iPhone 18 Pro.

Which new iPhone 18 Pro color would you buy out of these options? Let us know in the comments.
